dog.description_text:
London is a 5-year-old Chihuahua mix who weighs around 12 lbs and is about as loving as they come. She adores cuddling, gives plenty of kisses, and is happiest when she can be close to her people. At home, she’s calm, easygoing, and not particularly bothered by different sounds or everyday activity.

She’s house-trained and crate-trained, and while she can be a little anxious or fearful when first meeting new people or dogs, she just needs a little time to feel comfortable. Once she does, her sweet and affectionate personality comes right through.

Registered adopters interested in London can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
